# Natively Open 2.9.2 for macOS Apple silicon

This is the public-source build of the fork. It installs as **Natively Open** with its own settings and data directory, so an existing Natively installation stays in place. Connect the phone and configure provider keys again from this app.

- After Command+B hides the overlay, Command+H and Command+Shift+Enter capture without reopening it. Command+Shift+Enter also starts the answer while hidden.
- A connected phone receives the original PNG screenshot before the model response. The response streams to the phone, which follows new content to the bottom.
- DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (deepseek-flash) accepts screenshots in chat and direct assist. The retired Flash model IDs remain compatible.

The upstream private `natively-premium` module is unavailable to this fork. Premium-only features from the official app are absent here.

This public build is **ad-hoc signed and not Apple notarized** because the fork has no Developer ID signing credentials. macOS may block opening a downloaded copy. The source and build workflow are available in this repository. This release contains an arm64 installer for Apple silicon Macs only.
